lens: Skeptic. Every fabric was compared with the photo at the same physical scale: y_47306 (~530-940 px/m) against studio e1/e4 rescaled, and y_47300 (~300 px/m) against q15 rescaled x0.61. Measured: mean colour, B/R, luminance p10/p50/p90, high-pass column CV, and cover/back luminance per seat. Official ANA photos decide colour; in-flight photos (sans_*, fr57325_*) decide geometry. QA camera: q15 is ~0.3 m higher and closer than y_47300 (no armrests or pillows in frame), and q16/q17 do not match their references. Those are camera issues and were not scored. Working files are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA13/ (mosaic_cmp*.png, diam_cmp.png, fleck_tick_cmp.png, tick_close.png, q15top.png/p00top.png, st.py).

issues.title: Mosaic overcorrected: milky low-contrast dash field with a dark crack network between blocks
issues.evidence: mosaic_cmp.png / mosaic_cmp_close.png. q15 at the y_47306 scale: p90/p50 1.28 vs 1.79, p10/p50 0.76 vs 0.59, column CV 0.045 vs 0.107. The photo shows navy ground with crisp near-white dashes 3.5-14 mm long, and blocks visible only as density changes. In the render, sparse blocks join into dark irregular cracks around periwinkle dense blocks.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): ground 0.88 -> 0.72 (darker navy between dashes). lift (4.4, 4.6, 5.0) -> (6.2, 6.4, 6.8) for brighter dashes. Dash length lognormal median 4.0 -> 7.0 mm, sigma 0.45 -> 0.55, clip to 3-16 mm. Densities {0.30, 0.45, 0.62} -> {0.40, 0.52, 0.66}, so no block drops to near-empty navy. Delete the seam term (factor 0.08 -> 0). Target at the q15 scale: p90/p50 >= 1.65, p10/p50 <= 0.65. Then re-check yFabricC so the mean holds (L50 ~68).

issues.title: Tick columns still vanish at row distance, while close-up channels are too dark and the ticks too grey
issues.evidence: Photo-scale high-pass column CV: render 0.057 / 0.092 vs y_47300 0.112 / 0.179 (r12 seat 1 0.074, so seat 1 got worse). Close up: column CV 0.169 vs 0.098, p50 60 vs 77; the ticks are grey-white where the photo's are light lavender-blue on royal (tick_close.png).
issues.fix: synth_y_tick(): replace the sine envelope with a flattened one, env = 1 + 0.30 * tanh(2.2 * sin(...)) / tanh(2.2). This puts the energy in the fundamental, which survives mipmapping, instead of a peaky profile that only shows up close. Apply it to the strokes only: r = ratio * (1 + (env - 1) * (ratio > ratio.mean())). Lift the darks harder (0.25 -> 0.40) so the channels are royal, not navy. In 09_seats.js yFabric (shared, one line): c '#55607f' -> '#526290' (bluer ticks). Target at the q15 scale: column CV >= 0.11; close-up p50/p90 ratio within 10 % of y_47306.

issues.title: Back top: white hood rim, side knobs and ~9 cm of fabric above the pad in every front view (w12b-4 unaddressed)
issues.evidence: q15top.png vs p00top.png. y_47300: the pad crown is the back top. y_47306: 5-7 cm and no white. Render: a white rim ~1.5 cm across the top, grey knobs at the top corners, ~9 cm above the pad.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: raise the headrest pad, cover, fold and hem group by +0.03 m (the 6-way headrest at its top setting, as in the y_47300 hero shot). Or extend the back's top fabric sections 1.5 cm up and 1 cm aft so they wrap over the RS hood lip, and pull the hood front lip 1 cm aft and down so no white shows head-on. Move the top-corner knobs 2 cm aft behind the fabric crown, or delete them; no front photo shows them.

issues.title: Diamond: still rounded blobs on a strict lattice, now oversaturated violet
issues.evidence: diam_cmp.png: e1 B/R 2.60 vs y_47306 2.03, sat 0.62 vs 0.53, p90/p50 1.37 vs 1.61. The figures have soft round corners and identical spacing. The photo figures are pointed stars and diamonds with stepped edges, in uneven chains.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_diamond(): remove the GaussianBlur(1.0) on m. Jitter each site centre +-0.006 m and make hd per site 0.030-0.042. Use a star metric (du/a)**0.75 + (dv/b)**0.75 <= 1 so tips are pointed and edges concave between tips. Leave ~20 % of sites empty, or use a small hd, so the chains break irregularly. Raise the lift back to (3.1, 3.0, 2.6) to reach the photo's p90/p50 1.6. In 09_seats.js yFabricB (shared, one line): '#4f5f9c' -> '#53618f' to bring B/R from 2.6 toward 2.0.

issues.title: Fleck too faint and too fine at row distance (over-dimmed in w12)
issues.evidence: fleck_tick_cmp.png: y_47300 seat 2 vs q15 seat 4 at the same scale. Photo flecks are distinct, larger and sparser, p90/p50 1.90. Render flecks are tiny dim noise, p90/p50 1.49 at scale (1.70 native). q16's close seats still look snowy, so the problem is fleck size: small flecks look bright up close and vanish under minification.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck(): half-axis a 2.2-3.4 -> 3.0-4.2 mm, minimum spacing 5 -> 7 mm, keep cover ~0.11 (fewer, bigger petals). Lift (5.8, 5.3, 3.3) -> (6.4, 5.9, 3.7). Check q15 seat 4 at the photo scale: p90/p50 >= 1.8.

issues.title: Headrest covers still ~0.15 brighter (relative to the back) than the photo
Pillow is a smooth squircle with no corner ears, edge seam or weave
issues.evidence: y_47300: the pillows have pinched, pointed corner ears, a faint edge seam and a fine weave. e4b/e1: a round-cornered blob with a wavy top and a flat colour.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow: change the squircle to pull the corners out, X *= 1 + 0.12 * (sx*sz)^2 with corner thickness tapering to ~30 %. Add a 4 mm darker seam band at the perimeter. Give yPillow l: LAYER.yJacq at low strength.
